info.name: CafeFlow GraphQL Product Service
info.description: GraphQL operations and health checks for the CafeFlow product catalog.

body.raw: {"query":"mutation CreateProduct($input: CreateProductInput!) { createProduct(input: $input) { id sku name price stockQuantity inventoryStatus categoryId active createdAt } }","variables":{"input":{"sku":"COF-101","name":"Cappuccino","description":"Espresso with steamed milk","price":180,"stockQuantity":20,"categoryId":"coffee","active":true}}}

{"query":"query Products($page: Int, $limit: Int, $search: String) { products(page: $page, limit: $limit, search: $search, sortBy: CREATED_AT, sortDirection: DESC) { items { id sku name price stockQuantity inventoryStatus categoryId active } pageInfo { page limit totalItems totalPages hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } } }","variables":{"page":1,"limit":10,"search":"coffee"}}
{"query":"query Product($id: ID!) { product(id: $id) { id sku name description price stockQuantity inventoryStatus categoryId active createdAt updatedAt } }","variables":{"id":"{{productId}}"}}

{"query":"mutation UpdateStock($id: ID!, $stockQuantity: Int!) { updateProductStock(id: $id, stockQuantity: $stockQuantity) { id sku stockQuantity inventoryStatus updatedAt } }","variables":{"id":"{{productId}}","stockQuantity":4}}
{"query":"mutation DeleteProduct($id: ID!) { deleteProduct(id: $id) { success message deletedId } }","variables":{"id":"{{productId}}"}}
